corpus: synthetic code-ish texts, Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 dtype q8 via @huggingface/transformers 4.2.0 (onnxruntime-node 1.24.3)

longWorkload.note: ~1200 tokens/text; peak RSS dominated by activations, both modes converge

machine: darwin 27.0 arm64, node v22.22.3, fresh process per sample
method: bench-onnx-arena.ts (short) / bench-onnx-arena-long.ts (long); RSS = process.memoryUsage().rss; first download run excluded
verdict: NO measurable RSS delta on MiniLM-q8 in either workload (short: 292 vs 292 MB loaded, 310 vs 310 MB after batch; long: ~1129 vs ~1129 MB peak). Latency within noise (short 0.75 vs 0.75 ms/text; long 18.1 vs 17.9 ms/text) -- inside the 10% acceptance budget. The 200-300MB arena figure from external research does not reproduce on a 23MB model: the arena never grows past its initial chunk here.
